name: @lattice/example-clay
description: CLAY — a gallery exhibit. The ground is material: drag to raise it, and watch water, paths and everything standing on it resettle under your hand.
$comment: Six of nine. @lattice/sim has no economy, @lattice/persist nothing to save — this exhibit deliberately has no undo and no store, because docs/GALLERY.md's Clay row says the trap is building a tool rather than an exhibit, and a save button is the first thing a tool grows. @lattice/audio is absent for the reason the gallery has not settled: a page that makes noise before a visitor has touched it is worse than a silent one. @lattice/input is here by name as well as through the shared bootstrap: the brush claims every drag gesture away from the camera controller, which is the one thing this exhibit could not do without it.
